# Asmodensius-Native (v1.2.0)

> Windows-native freestanding C23, NASM AVX2/AVX-VNNI, and pure-integer CUDA PTX artificial-life simulation engine with exact integer matter/energy conservation, bit-exact multi-substrate replay, 77/77 CTest, 164/164 GPU differential checks, and 38 Pure Lean 4.35.0 declarations (26 substantive model, boundary, witness, and adversarial refutation theorems + 12 explicitly labeled sanity checks) about an abstract Nat model of its rules. C23/NASM/PTX code is not verified in Lean.

Author: Alexander Stephen Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648)
Repository: https://github.com/0thernes/asmodensius-native
Portal & Proof Blueprint: https://0thernes.github.io/asmodensius-native/
Software Heritage Snapshot: swh:1:snp:08a957772115194b51a4eadb77331b8bab261773
Licenses: Apache-2.0 (code, Lean 4 proofs, scripts) and CC-BY-4.0 (white paper, docs, figures, datasets)

## Canonical Entry Points

- [README.md](README.md): Overview, quickstart, usage, and verbatim 38-declaration Lean `#print axioms` verification block.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): 15 non-negotiable engineering laws (including Law 5 exact books, Law 8 indicator-only, Law 14 pure 7-bit ASCII/LF/no-tabs enforced on active tracked files by `tools/check_text.py`).
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Numbered claims ledger (`C01`..`C12`) with epistemic tiers and explicit falsification conditions.
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Threats to validity, negative hardware tradeoffs, formal-to-binary gap, and real-vs-metaphor boundary.
- [ERRATA.md](ERRATA.md): Chronological errata including the full 2026-11-26 statement audit (`#1`..`#11`) and `v1.2.0` closure table.
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Clean-clone step-by-step reproduction protocol and dated replication log.
- [SUBMISSION_READINESS.md](SUBMISSION_READINESS.md): Archival & preprint readiness ledger (not peer-reviewed).

## Formal Proofs, Blueprint & White Paper

- [lean/README.md](lean/README.md): 38 Pure Lean 4.35.0 declarations (`A01`..`A38`: 26 substantive + 12 labeled sanity checks), Palomar `Challenge.lean`/`Solution.lean` setup, and `scripts/test_lean_negative.py`.
- [docs/blueprint.html](docs/blueprint.html): Interactive strict-CSP, zero-CDN, WCAG 2.2 AA Lean 4 Proof Blueprint (audited by `scripts/check_blueprint.py`).
- [results/lean4-asmodensius-audit.txt](results/lean4-asmodensius-audit.txt): Verbatim `#print axioms` output (38/38).
- [results/lean4-multi-kernel.txt](results/lean4-multi-kernel.txt): Local 6-checker Windows transcript (`lean4` kernel, `leanchecker`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`, `nanoda_bin`; Ubuntu CI adds `lean4lean` + `bwrap` comparator).
- [paper/main.tex](paper/main.tex): 10-page AMS-LaTeX white paper (`dist/Donahue_2026_asmodensius_native.pdf`, `dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz`, `results/citation-audit.json`).
- [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md): Line-by-line Lean-to-C/PTX statement-fidelity matrix.

- [docs/DATASHEET.md](docs/DATASHEET.md), [croissant.json](croissant.json), [ro-crate-metadata.json](ro-crate-metadata.json), [codemeta.json](codemeta.json), [REUSE.toml](REUSE.toml): FAIR metadata & SPDX licensing.
